title: Toys were not made for aggressive 10 month olds
text:
Happy Van was destroyed in 5 minutes, exposed the inner lining that states all good things come to an end time to throw away after she removed all the stuffing and squeaky
Chicken lasted 3 days
Treats were good she enjoyed the chicken sticks and the 2 bags of snackies
If possible can I request tuff toys or no stuffing?
label: negative
